SHARK FRENZY

You are a great white shark, and everything is on the menu: fish, swimmers, people on the beach, octopus, seals, dolphins, orcas and blue whales. Small prey goes down in one bite. Big prey takes a few, and fewer as you grow.

Mouse steer · Hold left click or Shift boost
E or right click EAT (lunge bite) · Space JUMP
Joystick (bottom left) steers too · WASD / arrows · P pause · M sound · N music
Press EAT when prey is near your jaws (the button glows) to suck it in and swallow it. Jump near the surface to leap out and catch seagulls. Charge the shallows to slide onto the beach. Don't stay on land too long.

Music: “The Builder” and “Carefree” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0.
